label: IX.8, 1049b4–1050b6 — Three comparisons of actuality and capacity in Aristotle Θ.8
interpretation: Priority in account concerns the corresponding activity to which the account of a capacity refers. Priority in substance is argued from mature form and actuality as end. In the temporal argument, the prior source and the thing that comes to actuality are the same in kind and different in number. The individual’s capacity can precede its own exercise.
attribution: The passage states that actuality is prior in account and in substance, and that in the generation or acquisition under discussion what comes to actuality from potency always does so through a numerically different actual source that precedes what comes to be even though the individual’s capacity can precede its own exercise, which is the premise.
